newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Paxson Communications estimates up.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Paxson Communications estimates up.

text.p: -- Gruntal & Co said Monday it raised its EBITDA earnings estimate for Paxson Communications for 1997 to $1.41 a share from $1.23 and the estimate for 1998 to $1.99 a share from $1.41.

-- The 1997 estimated loss is now $0.14 a share versus a loss of $0.34 without preferred dividend payments, Gruntal said. The estimated net profit for 1998 has also been revised to $0.46 from $0.07 a share, Gruntal said.
-- Gruntal said the higher estimates reflect an anticipated more aggressive cash flow in the second half of 1997 and in 1998, when Paxson begins airing its infomercials in more U.S. homes.
-- Paxson sells infomercial time based on the number of households reached, and it will add seven new stations over the next year to reach between 28-32 million homes by year-end, Gruntal said.
-- Paxson shares were up 1/8 Monday at 12.
